description: Use this when a student wants the weighted course grade from categories such as homework 20%, tests 50%, final 30%. Each row has a score (percent, a fraction like 45/50, or a letter) and a weight; rows without a score count as still open. Returns the weighted average, the letter, how much weight is graded and open, and optionally what the open part must average to reach a target grade. Do not use it for a single final-exam question without categories.

name.description: Optional category label such as Homework. Never a person's name.

score.description: Percent (92), fraction (45/50) or letter (B+). Leave out for a category not graded yet.

weight.description: Weight of the category (usually percent of the course).

target_grade.description: Optional wanted course grade (percent or letter).

name: weighted_grade

link.description: Page of calculatorforgrading.com with the same inputs filled in.

title: Weighted average of categories
